export_model_to_executorch_portable: export a PyTorch model to ExecuTorch using the portable recipe with portable kernels
lower_exported_programs_to_executorch: lower exported PyTorch programs to an ExecuTorch program using to_edge_transform_and_lower
apply_remove_padding_idx_embedding_pass: apply the RemovePaddingIdxEmbeddingPass transform pass when lowering a model to ExecuTorch
validate_custom_sdpa_in_graph: validate that the custom_sdpa operator is present in the exported program graph
register_portable_recipe: register the portable recipe in the recipe registry for exporting models to ExecuTorch
